scope: Current source composition and the single already-completed synthetic CPU integration gate; independent verifier review remains separate.

CPU_GATE.transport_line_ending_correction: Local CRLF normalized to the original remote JSON LF; parsed values and all scientific source hashes unchanged; no repeated gate.

resolved_findings.problem: Installing the frozen interface also freezes existing q/v adapters.
resolved_findings.resolution: Production installation restores exactly the original A/B Parameter identities and bytes, preserves RNG, and leaves all visual/base parameters frozen.

resolved_findings.problem: Inherited training AST requires method.vision_original, initialized outside its extracted loop.
resolved_findings.resolution: Worker assigns model._llmcl_visual_original after frozen-vision installation and before the first training batch.

resolved_findings.problem: ResourceMonitor.finish requires a training_before snapshot absent from the extracted stage loop.
resolved_findings.resolution: Worker now records training_before and training_after around the inherited training execution.

resolved_findings.problem: CUDA FP32 folding would differ from the existing parent export arithmetic.
resolved_findings.resolution: Production fold now computes W+scale*(B@A) on CPU in FP32, casts to original storage dtype, then returns the replacement Linear to its original device; method.layers is cleared.

resolved_findings.problem: Compact resource windows originally followed 100 DEV generations while parent windows began in a fresh process.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both models now measure the same ordered five windows before any DEV generation in their respective independent resource processes.

resolved_findings.problem: Protocol initially named HostAdamW although original BudgetQV inherits the default optimizer branch.
resolved_findings.resolution: Protocol now retains the actual original AdamW selection; no new host_optimizer flag was added.

resolved_findings.problem: The old frozen asset view lacks dependencies for the inherited full training module.
resolved_findings.resolution: Worker and CPU gate accept the explicit independent LLMCL_ASSET view; the old view is not edited. Complete transported asset/runtime binding is still required in READY.

limits: The CPU integration check is not a real pretrained model quality or GPU memory result.
The scientific keep/close decision requires the parent each-domain F1 floor, actual complete package reduction, and all five matched GPU peak reductions.
Initial and final new DEV outputs must be scored only once after all phases finish successfully; existing anchors are copied only through their sealed proof chain.
Independent verifier source review and exact READY/transport admission remain required.
